observations: Photo 0 shows a large flat-screen TV with a black bezel, placed outdoors on a concrete surface.
The TV screen is off and reflects the surroundings, including a person's legs and a cardboard box.
The TV is leaning against a cardboard box with 'TV 75'' printed on it.
The screen surface appears to have smudges, dust, and minor scratches, especially near the bottom right corner.
The TV is not powered on; no image or display is visible.
The seller claims it is a 75-inch Samsung Smart TV with a power fault only, but no brand or model is visible on the TV itself.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

claims.claim: It has a power fault only
claims.evidence: The TV is off and not powered on; no internal components or power indicators are visible. The claim cannot be verified from the photo alone.

claims.claim: No dead pixel, no line on the screen, remote included. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The TV may not be a Samsung or may not be a smart TV as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the TV's bezel or back panel showing the brand and model name.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 75-inch outdoor TV, not a Samsung Smart TV.

risks.risk: The TV may have internal damage or be non-functional despite the power fault claim.
risks.proof: A video showing the TV powered on and displaying a clear image, or a photo of the power indicator and input ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, since the claim of 'power fault only' is unverified and the TV is off.

risks.risk: The screen may have dead pixels, lines, or other display defects not visible in the reflection.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the TV powered on, showing a test pattern or live content.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential display defects, reducing value.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the TV's bezel or back panel showing the brand and model name.
A video or photo of the TV powered on, displaying a clear image or test pattern.
A photo of the power indicator and input ports to confirm functionality.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
